Schema validation and runtime parsing for Aras Items, AML, XML and JSON.

- Parse named objects and whole Item collections directly from schemas.
- Handle all validation issues through SafeParse, or catch ValidationException from Parse.
- Validate nested Items, relationships, attributes and typed pipelines.
- Accept extra fields by default; enable strict shapes where needed.

Choose one archive for the target framework. Each contains one runtime DLL,
XML API documentation, the MIT license, deployment instructions and a build manifest.
Verify archive hashes against SHA256SUMS.txt.
